writeup.headline: Proto Labs rates Hold: strong trend, net cash and raised guidance, offset by a demanding valuation.
writeup.thesis: Proto Labs scores 61, a Hold, 4 points short of the Buy band. The stock's trend is the strongest factor (92), with shares up 75.6% from 12 months ago to 1 month ago and the price 24.5% above its 200-day average, and the balance sheet scores 100 thanks to net cash and no debt. Fundamentals are solid but middling: TTM revenue growth of 10.2%, a 45.4% gross margin, a 6.6% operating margin and a 10.1% FCF margin, with news helped by a raise in full-year 2026 revenue growth guidance to 10%-11% after a record Q3. Valuation holds the score back (25): in absolute terms the multiples are high at 3.9x sales, 38.4x FCF and 55.2x EBIT, with the FCF yield 2.4 pp below the 10-year Treasury yield. Against its own history the stock is expensive, with P/S more expensive than at 59 of the last 61 month-ends.
key_risks: High absolute multiples (55.2x EV/EBIT, 38.4x P/FCF) leave little room for a miss
